title: StablePFN: Stable Prediction with Causal-Aware Tabular Foundation Model

problem.claim: It is unclear whether PFN-based tabular prediction models can comprehend underlying causal structures and use causal information for stable prediction across environments.

gap.claim: The causal understanding and cross-environment stability of models pre-trained on causally generated data remain systematically unexplored.

contributions.claim: StablePFN integrates explicit causal awareness with stable predictive modeling in a tabular foundation model.
StablePFN jointly identifies the target variable's Markov Boundary and performs the primary prediction task using ground-truth causal structure available during synthetic data generation.
The Decouple-Discover-Predict architecture uses sample decoupling weights for Markov Boundary discovery and hard attention masking during inference to incorporate causal structural knowledge.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe StablePFN as a novel tabular foundation model that integrates explicit causal awareness with stable predictive modeling.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks reportedly show that StablePFN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in cross-environment prediction settings, especially under high bias.

narrative_sequence.summary: PFN-based tabular prediction models have advanced supervised learning across diverse tasks.
The abstract identifies unresolved questions about causal comprehension and stable prediction across environments.
StablePFN combines causal awareness, Markov Boundary discovery, and stable prediction through a Decouple-Discover-Predict architecture.
The authors report gains over state-of-the-art baselines on synthetic and real-world cross-environment benchmarks, particularly in high-bias settings.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify benchmark datasets, evaluation metrics, baseline identities, or quantitative results.
The abstract does not describe the causal assumptions, training details, or limitations.
